## TemporaryFileCopy interface

Local read result: a temporary copy of the content on the executing Mac.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface TemporaryFileCopy
```

## Remarks

The caller owns the copy once `fetch()` resolves and should `release()` it when done; the runtime also removes leftover copies after a bounded, documented lifetime.
